summary: Backend testing for Security Master new features (Bulk IOC Sweep, Sigma preview/import, Team Template sharing, Auto-Enrich on Enroll) + regression on fleet/cve/releases/plugins/workstation/ioc. All 15 pytest cases passed (100%).

minor.issue: Audit events reuse kind='cve_match' (comment acknowledges this). Consider adding dedicated 'bulk_sweep'/'sigma_import' kinds for cleaner filtering in the audit UI.

'shared' flag is accepted but there is no field for shared==False default returned from GET when a template omits the field (relies on Mongo missing-field sort). Minor — sort still works because absent 'shared' sorts after true in Mongo descending.
Sets cookie with secure=True + samesite='none' hardcoded; on non-HTTPS local dev the cookie won't stick. Not a bug in preview env (HTTPS) but worth flagging.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1016 lines and mixes auth, fleet, cve, releases, plugins, templates, ioc, sigma, health, startup — should be split into routers per domain for maintainability (>700 line rule).
Bulk-sweep and sigma-import both label audit events kind='cve_match' with a TODO-style comment. Introduce proper enum values so the audit log filter UI stays honest.
_run_ioc_for_workstation runs VT + Shodan queries sequentially per host in bulk_ioc_sweep — for large fleets this is O(hosts * providers) round-trips serially. Consider asyncio.gather across hosts.
sigma_import accepts arbitrary YAML with no size limit; a large payload could balloon per-workstation $push. Consider capping unique_hashes per import (e.g., 5000) or streaming.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral workstations via /api/enroll/generate + /api/agent/enroll and ephemeral plugin templates (TEST_ prefix). Auto-enroll workstation and TEST_ templates are cleaned up at end of each test. TEST_vt plugin (if created) is left enabled (matches existing env expectation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features + regression suite covered in /app/backend/tests/test_security_master.py. Uses xdist (2 workers). Note: TestBulkSweep::test_no_provider_returns_400 temporarily disables and re-enables all VT/Shodan plugins — if it crashes mid-run those plugins may stay disabled. Fixture 'sess' is module-scoped, so login happens once. Auto-enrich test sleeps 4s to let asyncio.create_task fire.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in the reviewed features.
